List workflows from API

Source: R/api_client.R
api_list_workflows.Rd

Fetch workflows with optional search and filters.

api_list_workflows(
  search = NULL,
  survey_type = NULL,
  recipe_id = NULL,
  user = NULL,
  limit = 50,
  offset = 0
)

Arguments

search

Text search

survey_type

Filter by survey type

recipe_id

Filter workflows that reference this recipe

user

Filter by author email

limit

Maximum results

offset

Skip first N results

Value

List of RecipeWorkflow objects

See also

Other api-workflows: api_get_workflow(), api_publish_workflow()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
api_list_workflows(survey_type = "ech")
} # }
